rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who expects bad results and has little hope.

example.english: I’m very pessimistic about the result of this interview; I think it will be a complete flop.
example.traditional: 我對今次面試結果好悲觀，覺得凍過水。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 gam1 ci3 min6 si3 git3 gwo2 hou2 bei1 gun1 gok3 dak1 dung3 gwo3 seoi2

rows.note: Use this for an estimate or forecast that deliberately allows for the worst case, as in 保守估計.

example.english: A pessimistic estimate is that this building will take two years to complete.
example.traditional: 保守估計，呢幢樓要起兩年先完成。
example.jyutping: bou2 sau2 gu2 gai3 ne1 tong4 lau4 jiu3 hei2 loeng5 nin4 sin1 jyun4 sing4
